notes.title: 'UXcalibur' Update: Weekly Tournaments, Auto-Cam, Sectors & Other improvements!
notes.content: [p]Hello Runners ❤️‍🔥[/p][p]This update brings you a bunch of user experience improvements, both small and big! [/p][p][/p][h3]Weekly Tournaments[/h3][p]Every Monday we select a random community map for the Weekly Tournament. Results lock the following Monday. Ghosts are revealed on the livestream, where we also unveil the next map![/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/2fc27aac7b8e0ad6e234400bea2e3d3d5311397d.png"][/img][/h3][h3]Auto-cam[/h3][p]If you're playing on controller you no longer need to touch the Right Stick, don't believe me? Watch me beat the game without touching camera once! It's the auto-cam's first version so your feedback is much appreciated to help us improve further. You can also use Right Stick press to quickly reset the camera.[/p][previewyoutube="4Y0OqVOKs5I;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Sprays[/h3][p]Select your spray and use \[G] to leave your mark on the environment (also works in Multiplayer). We're happy to add your own custom sprays, just send them to our [url="https://discord.gg/rbm"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/9bef91679e5098ce81a023e8fc8295b78e976805.png"][/img][/p][h3]HUD Lab[/h3][p]Enable Pro mode in the HUD Lab to track sector times, compare against your best run, and see your current best time. It’s a powerful tool to improve your performance and helps your audience instantly follow the action.[/p][p]This great idea came from the community - if you have more suggestions, leave them on our [url="https://discord.gg/rbm"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/c74587673183f4fb31a1fe3fb54fa1df221b6987.png"][/img][/p][h3]Multiplayer[/h3][p] While in the Multiplayer lobby you can now download and add community maps without having to go into main menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/7af5693f530d6c31cd5612d40db2025aa2a7c3b1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Level Select[/h3][p]We added new tabs into level select that allow you to view how many tokens you collected in each level, what's your world rank or amount of restarts per each level. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/4a449188597287d7decc86774a4ad3fd6d9a754d.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Skins[/h3][p]Two new community skins added: Lumberjill by Kironet and Egger by Big Egg. You can also create your own skin! Just reach out on our [url="https://discord.gg/rbm"]Discord[/url] and we'll teach you how, it's quite easy.[/p][previewyoutube="y3iM93wgPEs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p]* Free camera setting moved to in-game setting[/p][p]* FPS display setting moved to in-game setting[/p][p]* Tournaments showing 'in XY hours/minutes"[/p][p]* Global statistics header updated accordingly to filters[/p][p]* Screenshots[/p][p]   - Stored in dedicated directory[/p][p]   - Stored as PNG[/p][p]   - Official in-game screenshot (F10, in settings)[/p][p]   - Shutter sound[/p][p]   - Can be super-sized (settings/game/misc)[/p][p]* Automatic camera improvements[/p][p]* Controller support for map creations - single click on A instead of doubleclick[/p][p]* When spectating ghost, escape will trigger 'play solo'[/p][p]+ Create mode[/p][p]   - Map name and description check before upload[/p][p]   - Start/Exit prefabs checks before upload[/p][p]   - Typing in input field does not trigger editor actions[/p][p]   - Mouse scroll does not affect editor when scrolling in other windows[/p][p]+ Sectors for maps[/p][p]+ HUD lab[/p][p]   - Supports notifications[/p][p]   - Switched on/off per element[/p][p]   - Personal best for map and sectors can be enabled[/p][p]+ Camera reset (Q and/or right controller stick press)[/p][p]+ Tokens displayed in level table per map[/p][p]+ Controller auto camera for nitro/flying[/p][p]+ Vibrations enabled for build[/p][p]+ Archived maps opened with level select achievement[/p][p]+ World ranks in level select[/p][p]+ Scroll view tool for capturing whole scroll area screenshot[/p][p]+ Lumberjill and Egger skins[/p][p]+ Multiplayer: adding community maps to library from lobby[/p][p]+ Mod support : is finish screen & booleans block marked in memory[/p][p]+ Multiple tag support - two tags only for testing[/p][p]+ Hints can be disabled from settings game/misc[/p][p]+ Vibrations power in settings[/p][p]+ Auto camera enabled for controller[/p][p]+ Intro skipping polished ('Hold to skip' + radial progress bar)[/p][p]@ FPS counter disappearing fixed[/p][p]@ Steam : forcing restart after branch update (preventing need of manual restart)[/p][p]@ Multiplayer[/p][p]   - Counting map time from previos map[/p][p]   - 'Map does nopt support leaderboard' when party leaderboard is present in lock screen[/p][p]@ Lost UI selection in hub pause menu[/p][p]@ Auto camera controller/keyboard switch fixed[/p][p]@ Crash during game closing[/p][p]@ Statistics sorting: 'jumping' lines with empty entries[/p][p]@ Intro looping fixed[/p][p]@ Intro 'Hold to skip' text disappearing[/p][p]@ Multiplayer button is not skipped when main menu is displayed for first time[/p][p]@ Ghosts do not play vibration effects[/p][p][/p][p]If there's something else you'd like to see in the next update, drop a comment on this post.[/p][p][/p][p]Or even better, join our [url="https://discord.gg/rbm" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Portals 🌀 Parkour Racing in 4D!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Runners![/h1]
We're excited to share that Rocket Boots Mania now supports racing [b]through the 4th dimension![/b] Yup, we've added Portals to Create Mode and they are so much fun! 🤩

[h2]Portal Tower[/h2]
You can find the first map with portals in the recommended section of Community Creations. Try it out and let us know how you like it. It's called "Portal Tower" 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/b0fb29ebeca09d4f27c3e99f0dd906584984f467.png[/img]
You can of course use the portals to build your own maps too! It's quite simple. Place both the 'in' and the 'out' portal in the Create Mode scene, select both and then hit [CTRL] + [SHIFT] + [L] to link them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/632ad1cd009ba99f740acb433eba02dd5c4de734.png[/img]
And yes, of course we're already planning future updates that will leverage this functionality to link other "logic" type objects like buttons, switches, gates and whatever else we come up with. Share your ideas in the comments here on Steam! 📝

If you're curious to see more about portals, check one of the livestreams where we were building the first portal map. Don't forget to subscribe to catch other updates early - we're usually live at least 3 times a week.
[previewyoutube=cvChEJp3WmM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Create Mode Updates[/h2]
You asked and you shall receive. Here are a bunch of additions to the Create Mode that were requested by you.

You can now choose between different environments / time of day conditions. Open the level menu (the three lines in the top left corner) and choose between 'Islands Dusk' and 'Islands Afternoon'. We'll continue adding the other environments (and maybe completely new ones) in the upcoming updates. What environments do you think would be coolest? Let us know! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/e8d189bd3624fda19f3394fef7d42e170619cc57.png[/img]
There's now a new modular track pack of models that allow you to build gravity defying tracks just like those in the Snowman bonus level. Horizontal, vertical, there are really no limits to how you can use these.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/d043d9d0f2d431586b413ed942b6d59c6bd02df7.png[/img]
Of course we also had to include the shock gates for some additional challenge. 🤓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/fd6111935468a919a71badb73273f34f5a8dca1c.png[/img]
And on a special request we've also added the individual crab model, please be nice to them! 😂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/2697a3bf79a3dbdcb0805a2b0dbc8b4f15881c06.png[/img]

[h2]New Outfit[/h2]
We have a new awesome outfit for Zoe created by Soullessrun, thanks! 😍 If you'd like to create outfits or even completely new character models, stop by our Discord and we can teach you how.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/38c9d902ff9d696d37f130c593180d760f5478d1.png[/img]

[h2]Cloud Saves[/h2]
Another frequently requested feature was added - cloud saves allow you to chase records on multiple devices and your progress will be automatically synced (as long as you're connected to the internet of course). Let us know if everything's working or if you encounter some issues.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/d1d30a24fd97006480763bd6662046b507706bae.png[/img]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
Sometimes we get asked: "What's better - controller or keyboard and mouse?" While controller is the more chill way to play I'd recommend mouse and keyboard if you're serious about chasing the records. 
I'd also encourage you to bind jump to [Left Mouse Button]. I've done it a couple of months ago based on the recommendation from LinT and I just love it! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/6f592a108ec61904be6c57e0430164ef89d48415.png[/img]

All input can be changed in Settings > Input.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/094f2c8a334fecd982d9acb318a5094e0c11f857.png[/img]
To prove a point about total freedom of input mapping in our game I once mapped the controls to my racing sim, it was a surprisingly fun experience, check the video below 😂
[previewyoutube=sA_AAfP9EEY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Temporary / FYI[/h2]
As a part of full controller support for free camera, we moved camera acceleration button to be the same as nitro (Default is Right Mouse Button/RT2 on controller). This is temporary and in the next update there will be a dedicated mapping in the input settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/03d0b7771132539719e33f315b524322d2f872b8.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixing / Optimization[/h2]
As usual we've done a bunch of things around the whole game to improve the experience. You can check the full log in the main menu for detailed information.

[b]You've read all the way here?[/b] Let us know by hitting the like button further below, drop a comment, and join us on Discord! You certainly care about the game as much as we do and we’d love to hear your thoughts on this update as well as where you’d like the game to go next! Every like and comment helps grow the awareness of this awesome game, thanks! <3

notes.title: Speedrun Mode and Much More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Runners![/h1]
Thank you for the incredible response to the 1.0 release! Seeing all the new records and community creations has been amazing 🤩

We have a another cool update for you today, so let's dive in!

[h2]Speedrun Mode [/h2]
This new mode unlocks after you finish the game, and the goal is simple: beat it as fast as possible! ⏱️

Collect 15,000 tokens to unlock the final level, complete it, and stop the dedicated in-game timer to secure your spot in the Speedrun Valhalla Leaderboard.

Huge thanks to our Discord beta testers and everyone joining our live streams to help us refine it! 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8d8bc2889ca2bd845db79cfee05c32665736fc3b.png[/img]
[h2]New models for Create Mode[/h2]
We see how much you're enjoying Create Mode, so we're giving you even more control over your creations! 👷‍♂️🚧

[h3]Island Pack[/h3]
With this island pack, you can fully customize your environments! It includes an empty terrain, two medium rocks, one big rock, three palm trees, three flowers, and a fern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3139d4d3049037b50b8223a4d381e1e6ca57d58b.png[/img]
[h3]Modular Containers[/h3]
You asked for ROCKETEX containers, and we delivered! We also tweaked their dimensions to make them modular, so they snap together easily. Now you can build mazes, structures, or anything else you can imagine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/625d2589e1821c70906771244225d1e91744f110.png[/img]
[h3]Glass Panels[/h3]
Some of you loved the glass panels but needed doors and windows, so here they are! 🙂

And just in case you didn’t know, glass panels are slippery, making them perfect as blocker-type obstacles since players can't wallrun on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/03bcf73e331a8ebfb3717c49b99cab15d6ffca2f.png[/img]
[h3]Wood Crate[/h3]
Of course, we had to add the legendary wood crate! Now you can practice box-jumping and create some awesome maps with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/bfb096fd6daec077683915ae21eac3d82831aacc.png[/img]
[b]Fun fact:[/b] We discovered a physics bug with this crate model early in development. Jumping off the corners gives you a huge boost, opening up some incredible paths and WRs.

The community loved it so much that we decided to keep it as an actual [i]feature[/i] of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/7e91b06149983739b5b70b0fd4d26635e33c2b11.png[/img]
[h2]New Character[/h2]
You’ve probably noticed plenty of community-created outfits in the game. With this update, we’re introducing something completely unique: a brand-new character.

Meet [i]Dino Muscle[/i], created by Omed (aka KickyWonka), one of our amazing community members who has already built some incredible maps in Create Mode. 🤩 Unlike most user-created outfits, this one features a fully unique mesh and serves as a proof of concept for where we’d like to take the game next.

Over the past few months, we’ve developed a pipeline for importing custom-made characters. If you’d like to give it a shot, join us on Discord! We’ll show you how, whether it’s a simple texture modification or a brand-new model like Omed’s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/729ebae546e3100e46919599692349f612d4a987.png[/img]
[h2]Restart to last Checkpoint[/h2]
We already had a dedicated restart button, but some of you requested a [i]"restart to last checkpoint"[/i] option. This quickly became a personal favorite for me, especially for Speedrun Mode.

By default, you can press [b][L][/b] to restart to the last checkpoint. We placed it further from WSAD to avoid accidental triggers, but you can remap it in the settings as usual (I use [b][F][/b] 🤓). You can also remap this on your gamepad as well. If there’s no checkpoint, this button will restart the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8b05a92ee811d69ee0c4937e85d5fe28a4cb3a29.png[/img]
[h2]Training Adjustments[/h2]
We adjusted the level layout on the first training map, Rocket Jump. A full explanation, including a community-wide vote, can be found in our Discord polls channel, but here’s the TLDR:
[list][*]The best path/strategy on this map could give new players the wrong impression.
[*]We love the strat, but it's better suited for maps deeper in the game rather than the first level.
[*]Training should welcome new players, not make them question the game. 😅[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/46ac30346d713a599401f90955f5153aff0648db.png[/img]
[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list][*]Water reflections have been disabled in the Jungle Arena hub and levels.
[*]This provides a significant performance boost for many players.
[*]On my setup (a 5-year-old mid-tier gaming PC with an RTX 4070 Ti), FPS more than doubled![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3d9218d52681fbcacdb4b7c3e5327c6b4af44caf.png[/img]
[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
As always, we've made a few other quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback. Check the in-game change log for the full list!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/91deeb8085ca472d1f03401e9b2175134153630c.png[/img]
[h2]Livestream[/h2]
We stream live every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at [b]8 PM Prague time / 11 AM PST[/b].

Click the image to join today's stream, and consider subscribing to stay up to date! 😉

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IfVURH3M3d8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/ecd70c25b35bdef4826b5c1384eafac0d9ab5bb7.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Some Thoughts on 1.0 and Future[/h2]
If you've made it this far, I just want to say [i]thank you[/i] for being a dedicated part of this community! It's because of players like you that we get to keep pushing forward on this amazing journey.

We've poured everything into building a solid game, and we're humbled by the [b]100% positive reviews[/b] so far. We'll do everything in our power to maintain that because we truly believe in our vision of [i]Parkour Trackmania[/i]. This game is built together with an incredible community that keeps improving, creating awesome maps and skins, and helping it thrive for years to come.

This is just the beginning. While we may not have millions of players [i]yet[/i], I believe people will recognize what we've built and will join us soon.

Thanks for being here early, before we take off. You're legends.

Hit like, leave a comment, and join us on our live stream or Discord. We'd love to hear your thoughts on where you'd like the game to go next!

notes.title: The CREATE MODE is here!🏃‍♂️🔥
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Runners![/h3]

It's been a minute since the last update and we are truly happy to be back with a bunch of cool updates! Obviously the big one is the Create Mode, but there's more, check the video 👇

[previewyoutube=TQKkDUPqIi0;full][/previewyoutube]
Alright, let's dig into it. Below you can read more about the Create Mode, Community Creations, Speed Effects, New HUD, New Training hub and the RocketEx lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/02aecaa40c92fd09c8b88a490fd2e7f5dba5a6fa.jpg[/img]

The main item on our "Early Access list of promises" is now ready for testing. You can browse the library of models, place them in the scene, move and rotate them around to create your own maps! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/a05296dd96ac7cbff64ca7e628918a7b9520c98d.jpg[/img]
The community creations menu allows you to conveniently browse and play maps created by other players. It also allows you to easily find the "latest" uploaded creations or the "recommended" ones that we'd like to highlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/63bdde5fbd5c25c7052ac125bd80883bd9e773ff.jpg[/img]
Special thanks to the few early creators from Discord that helped us iron out the initial bugs by submitting their awesome maps! 🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3a417dd7310d95890381e95faaf55d0106f9ad10.jpg[/img]
We added a few camera effects and new HUD to increase the sensation of going fast. As you build up speed the FOV increases, the edges of your screen become blurry and speed lines begin rendering around your character. The new HUD displays the amount of boost and nitro you currently have and also has a decent flame VFX to support the feeling of "being on fire"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8845145c84f6579c28c7462aa8da5722cdc4e48e.jpg[/img]
We added a dedicated starting hub called "Training" with a couple of levels that teach new players the basics. We also implemented a new system for input which automatically detects whether you are playing on keyboard and mouse or controller and displays appropriate hints for controls mapping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/317559694876248c7350385971727d05c0ffc514.jpg[/img]
As we are nearing the release of the game we started considering other aspects, such as the lore. You can now find RocketEx containers scattered around the hubs and tracks. You will soon learn more about this company, what it does and what it stands for.

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
As usual, there's a bunch of other improvements that you'll notice when chasing your records:
- New Rocket Boots VFX that are more clean and stylish
- Improved flying mechanics that allow you to more easily go in desired direction
- Improved lighting, materials, textures and sun reflections
- Smoother transitions between levels thanks to the hypertube system 
- Improved outfit selection screen that now filters individual characters
- Reworked parts of the Rocket Island with a new final zone
- Additional support for Controller and other input improvements
- Polished levels in Islands and Mountains hubs
- Slide is now a hold action
- Flip can now break objects
- Wallrun gives you a slight upward velocity when you begin wallrunning
- Other minor tweaks and bug fixes to improve the user experience

Consider joining our Discord to receive latest news, participate in beta testing, and most importantly to let us know what you think of this update.

Hello Rocket Maniacs!

Something in your way? No worries, during power-slide you are in "crush-mode" and you can easily handle slamming through a few boxes. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/1a2e5922feb803e060e2cb491f1a01e88f66afd2.jpg[/img]

It is definitely a different kind of experience when you want to take it easy and sit back, relax in your sofa and boot up RBM on a huge screen with a gamepad in your hands. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/6245dd7f931de3d82b0afcabd2f6760e28799a54.jpg[/img]

If you have played this game before you will see A TON of other smaller or bigger improvements anywhere you look. From the re-design, improved performance, tweaked animations all the way to changes in UI and menu layout.

Antonin

notes.title: Rocket Boots Mania 0.911 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/cf6ea90fccf0e94fa2c9072a5c24b25b6316abaf.jpg[/img]

Hello Rocket Maniacs!
New year is upon us and that means one thing for RBM - even cooler updates!!!

[h1][b][i]- MOUNTAINS RE-DESIGN
- 2 NEW TRACKS
- CHECKPOINTS 2.0
- BRAKING
- BUG FIXING[/i][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3f2409ca096550a937e924ce2c306d7df0ffc0fc.jpg[/img]

Oh man, re-designing the environments is so much fun because it instantly improves the game feel and this is perhaps my most favorite redesign yet. We are trying to make the environments easily distinguishible and want you to feel not only the visual difference but also the gameplay difference. Mountains now feature the snow canons which lower your visibility and also utilize the new modular tracks system as well as hanging physical platforms. You can find mountains in its own section in the campagin menu.

[h1][url=https://discord.gg/rbm]>> JOIN DISCORD<< [/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/d503d39f7b255ff60837e95aa4eb6715a3b730fb.jpg[/img]

The first map is called Downhill and is a little bit of twist on the whole game, a kind of experiment to be honest. In most arenas you are trying to get up and in this one, you go down instead, we are curious about your feedback. Stay safe and enjoy the huge cuts :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/88b7fa182c0c1ea7b7cb282e267e3d0c37de5889.jpg[/img]

The second map - Ice Tower is packed with action, a lot of small platforms hanging from the construction, some possibilities for cutting have already been exposed by the elite beta testing team and we expect more to come as you dive into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/df08ff82aa7dafd70f9e999bc22dfe1e11bf81cb.jpg[/img]

Basically since the beginning of this whole project we are trying to figure out what is the best solution for the checkpoints, should they be mandatory or voluntary? Obviously we dont want to force people to follow certain path but cutting can turn into reducing the playtime drastically, one of the changes in this build is a new checkpoint prefab with minimal "footprint" which can be placed almost anywhere and is only used as "safe-point" for casual people. On this map it works great because it is so vertical, but wouldnt work on Downhill at all. Let us know what you think

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/7bdec014f1f4dbeb820f8a8e54a11d58d2950efd.jpg[/img]

For quite some time we are moving towards the velocity driven movement system and we constantly try to improve the game feel, braking is a relatively new feature and we are still figuring out where exactly this fits in the game. With the latest update if you press back during jump the player will no longer accelerate backward, it will come to a stop until you land. Especially useful for low-end to mid-end players on small platforms (must have on Ice Tower).

Dont forget to send your screenshots to #hall-of-fame and [b]MAKE SURE TO POST VIDEOS[/b]!!

Hello Rocket Maniacs! Buckle up, grab your cocktail and let's dive into the most epic update yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/1b3d783e8e22c42745fa24ab2bebb75173f3b937.png[/img]

Do I even need to write anything here? Just marvel at this glorious picture above for a second. RBM is a great game, we all know that, but one thing that was missing was some really cool environment, well, not anymore, with this update you are about to experience this tropical pleasure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/40022ffaef390bfc4da0a30d219c1717744c2802.png[/img]

And which map won the "first-to-be-redesigned" award? Lemon! That's right, one of the most fun and beloved maps had to be the first as it represents the tropical vibe the most. Build up momentum, collect lemons and throw them into the huge mixer, that is the concept in a nutshell. We have added one new cool feature - the conveyor belt. If you figure out how (it is not rocket science) you can turn it on and spawn a few extra lemons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/0218b643263fd722a027e5b9d33d85e5a371d37e.png[/img]

As if this update wasn't packed enough we included a few hidden statues which you can search for on the Lemon Island. We'd like to expand this concept into something like collectibles on more maps, so we are testing the waters to see how you like it. There are 3 hidden statues in the Lemon level, once you find them take a screenshot and post it to our Discord so people know you are the real deal!

[h1][url=https://discord.gg/rbm]>> CLICK TO JOIN DISCORD<< [/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/36497b69ba486ea32e31780590c3e396e426c3ef.png[/img]

The jump is essential to the game so that is why we decided to give it another pass. You can now brake if you press the oposite direction, the character no longer turns when you brake which makes it easier (especially for casual players) to make tight jumps as it it less confusing. We have also ramped up the visual turning speed mid-air so you no longer feel the character is rotating from a wrong pivot point - this doesnt affect the gameplay at all, but boy can you feel it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/82656080d8c58b0231e4c52613728bd9d4ebb917.png[/img]

We are constantly improving the game in all aspects and there are always updates down the line which work with these kind of updates, we have more plans for handles and that is why we have improved the looks and feels of handles as well as created some new fancy platform materials - I personally love the sun reflecting on the rubber pads - let me know what you think on our Discord!

Yep, that is about it for this update, we are extremely excited to hear your feedback for the Islands and cannot wait for your screenshots with the hidden statues, now go break some records maniacs!
